title: Trying out addjson never files a real task
goal: Five tasks titled x were filed on 2026-09-23 by runners trying the filing command out, and each one shows on the dashboard as real work until somebody drops it. Filing should refuse a title that says nothing, and a dry run should file nothing.
notes: Reproduced 2026-09-23 23:02: node queue/bin/queue.mjs addjson {"title":"x"} --dry-run wrote queue/tasks/p2-normal/x-5.json (status pending), dropped by hand. Earlier ones: x.json 2026-09-23T21:34, x-2 00:14, x-3 01:31, x-4 03:00 (all created stamps, all dropped).
acceptance: queue.mjs addjson with --dry-run prints what it would file and writes no task
A title shorter than three words is refused with a message saying why
Dropped x, x-2, x-3, x-4 and x-5 stay dropped
